officialValidationSource: JAMB IBASS public programme records, accessed 2026-08-20

confidenceDefinitions.high: Draft UTME core matched an official IBASS record and the prior secondary cross-check.
confidenceDefinitions.medium: An official IBASS record was returned, but it introduced an alternative, restriction, or material difference requiring target-institution verification.
confidenceDefinitions.unvalidated: No record was returned for the sampled official institutions; do not use the baseline as an admission answer.

materialDifferences.geology: Draft used a Geography-led route; the returned University of Lagos record lists English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
materialDifferences.surveying-geoinformatics: Draft included several third-subject alternatives; the returned University of Lagos record lists English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
materialDifferences.french: Draft required French; the returned University of Lagos record permits English plus three Arts or Social Science subjects.
materialDifferences.mass-communication: Draft used a common Literature/Economics/Government route; the returned University of Lagos record uses Literature in English plus two Arts or Social Science subjects.
materialDifferences.engineering-o-levels: Returned University of Lagos engineering records list Further Mathematics among five O-Level credits; the generic draft had not made that institution-specific requirement explicit.

futureDisplayRule: Show 'Common combination — confirm for your university' and direct students to JAMB IBASS until a target-institution lookup returns the authoritative course record.
